# Post 3 grounding digest — verify-and-consolidate pass (v5, 2026-07-16)

**Verdict: the post is soundly grounded.** Every lab number re-verified against the repo, every load-bearing Sans quote is now page-pinned against the open-access chapter PDF (a gate closed), the *reelle Mitte* philological note is confirmed in the German text, and the guard is clean. Two corrections to carry: (1) the EL §198 state-triad citation drifted to the main paragraph in v5 and belongs in the **Remark** (§198R, B&D p. 273) — the v5 "locus fix" was a mis-correction; (2) the phrase "no party is a veto" on the symmetric three-cycle receipt is unbacked by any located finding and should be reworded.

## Claim (correct altitude)
Hegel's syllogism — two extremes holding together through a middle — is the mediated triad, and his standing complaint against merely external middles (the formal syllogism's abstract middle; communication in the mechanical process) is the conduit/integrator distinction in another vocabulary. The bridge is a homology of shape drawn inside Hegel's own Mechanism chapter (communication → real middle), not an identity of referents and not an anticipation of the criterion. The draft holds this altitude throughout.

## Primary passages — status

The v5 sourcing-note claim that the locus was "fixed" to the main paragraph is a mis-correction. Cite §198R; propagate to Post 6 |

## Secondary — status
**Sans 2018 (anchor).** Now fully page-verified against the open-access chapter PDF ([Tübingen repository](https://publikationen.uni-tuebingen.de/xmlui/bitstream/handle/10900/120980/Sans_053.pdf?sequence=1)): "conceptual relations as such are real" p. 192; "founds its conclusion" + middle-replaces-copula p. 194; "aims at establishing the Concept as something objective, to wit really existing," Anselm/Descartes, "a really existing, objective universal" pp. 201–202; **"Subjectivity as well as objectivity are determinations of the Concept as such and do not refer directly either to mind or to nature" p. 202 — the previously un-anchored page, now pinned (gate closed)**; "[reale Mitte]" p. 203; "astonishing… mechanism chapter" pp. 204–205; "should not be taken in a reductionist sense," "spirit as such transcends mechanism," prayers "in a detached and uninvolved manner" p. 206. Print pagination 191–213 confirmed on the PDF face.
**Stein 2016 (threat).** Quotes at pp. 149, 151 as in the plan's [✓]; not re-checkable this pass (Hegel Bulletin paywalled); the draft's rhyme-not-confirmation framing and "Stein's Concept is the modeler" hedge are intact.
**Moss 2013 (convergent).** "a triad of syllogisms, which altogether constitute a process of alternating middle terms" verified in the publisher's abstract ([PDC](https://www.pdcnet.org/ipq/content/ipq_2013_0053_0001_0073_0085), [PhilPapers](https://philpapers.org/rec/MOSHFM)); IPQ 53(1):73–85 confirmed; the p. 78 in-text locator stays gated on the published PDF.
**Kreines 2006 (positioning)** two-camp vocabulary, **Pippin 2019 (positioning)** "science of pure thinking" (not "deflationary"), **Redding 2023 (convergent/prior-art)**, **Christensen 2024** (Erkenntnis 90(8), 3447–3482, corrected in v5), **Smith 1988 / Vieweg 2017 / Harvey 2002 / Lawvere 1991 / Protin 2025 / Günther / Burt / Obstfeld / Simmel (prior-art)** — all as previously verified; Harvey direct quote and Redding p. 43 still gated.

## Lab receipts — all re-verified against the repo this pass
- **256-form census, 24 triadic (9.4%), Φ bands 232 @ 0.0 / 8 @ 0.5 / 16 @ 2.0, P(triadic | mediator reads both) = 15.0% (24/160)** — recomputed directly from `org_frontier/corpus/results/population.csv`; matches `corpus/FINDINGS.md` and `STRUCTURAL_FINDINGS.md` §2–3. The draft's three-band statement is exactly right.
- **Minimal pair (relay Φ=0.00 vs joint-commit Φ=2.00)** — `corpus/FINDINGS.md` (pure_relay 0.00; ats_strict_bottleneck 2.00, the resume/manager-profile form).
- **Same-wiring twin that factors** — the 136/160 reads-both-but-dyadic population fact, same census.
- **Committing chains Φ=2.0 at n=3–6** — `org_frontier/multiparty/results/chains.csv` (2.000000 at every length); `STRUCTURAL_FINDINGS.md` §6; corroborated by q65 (depth 1–4, Φ=2.0 constant).
- **Relay chains of two, three, four nodes factor to Φ=0** — `org_frontier/essays/mediated_or_irreducible.md` (lines ~52–54), sourced to `recurrence/iit_experiments.py` E3.
- **q213 car dealer** — `questions/q213_contingent_irreducibility/FINDINGS.md`: constrained dealer triadic Φ=2.0, core {M,D,B}; bypass restores the maker–buyer edge, dealer leaves the core, Φ 2.0→0.0, contingency margin 2.0; clearinghouse intrinsic under the same bypass.
- **Symmetric three-cycle (the rotating triad's extensional face)** — supported by q11 (`rot_ring` Φ=2, triadic, full core, n=3–6), q149 (ring Shapley spread 0.000 = even shares, n=5–6), q214 H5 (symmetric Heider triad Φ=6.0, all three in core). **Flag:** the draft's clause "no party is a veto" is unbacked — q112 shows every core party of the mediated triad holds a veto, and no located receipt shows the symmetric cycle veto-free. Reword to what the receipts say: no distinguished single-party binder (q101/q102) and even value thirds (q149/q113).

## Refutation condition (from SERIES_PLAN §3, met as written)
Sans defeats "merely a logical form," but his ontology is teleological and self-realizing, so it licenses "the syllogism is a real structure," not "a causal structure whose irreducibility is partition-sensitive." That last step is the series' own; if the post cannot make it, it collapses into a footnote of Post 4. The draft makes the step explicitly and owns it ("The Move the Resemblance Does Not License"), grades the fit (tightest at the conduit pole, loosest at the integrator pole), and enters the topology gap (rotating vs fixed-star middle) as a real limit. Condition satisfied.

## Guard check — clean, two watch notes
No anticipation claim anywhere ("not that Hegel anticipated the criterion," the closing bound is explicit); no demotion of Φ — the instrument is affirmed as "thin and decidable is what makes it an instrument," and the census is presented as the one measured post in the series. Watch: (a) the close's "the same boundary the criterion reads, not yet the same computation" is the single place above "same shape" altitude — it was the panel-approved retirement of "in everything but notation," so keep, but do not let later edits drop the "not yet the same computation" half; (b) "a cut and a count" in the final paragraph reads as method description, not demotion — fine as is.

## Gates before posting
1. **Fix in draft + sourcing note:** §198 → §198R (Remark; B&D p. 273); reword "no party is a veto."
2. Physical B&D checks: §181R p. 254; §182 pp. 254–255 ("begrifflos"); §198R p. 273.
3. Physical di Giovanni checks: now only pp. 635–636 (communication, laws/morals, scent) lack cross-corroboration; pp. 588, 631, 641, 642–643 are corroborated by Sans's dual citations and the German text but the standing series gate still applies.
4. Moss p. 78 in-text locator + DOI against the published PDF (paywalled).
5. Stein 2016 physical/paywalled re-check (pp. 149, 151).
6. Redding p. 43 caveat; Harvey 2002 direct quote (Cloudflare-gated); Protin arXiv version pin — carried from v4.
7. Author-only: the real anonymized middle for the opener; flagship-term freeze (integrator vs necessary middle) across Posts 4–9.

## New scholarship
Nothing newer than 2026-07-10 located (searched Hegel + syllogism + mechanism/middle term + network/IIT). The one new source artifact is the Tübingen open-access PDF of the Sans chapter itself, which closed the page gate on the mind-or-nature quote.

digest.refutation_condition: Sans defeats the "merely a logical form" objection — Hegel's objective syllogism is a real structure of the whole — but his ontology is teleological and self-realizing, explicitly transcending mechanism, so it licenses "the syllogism is a real structure," not "a causal cause-effect structure whose irreducibility is partition-sensitive." That last move is the series' own to make; if the post cannot make it, it rests on Sans's ontology and collapses into a strong footnote of Post 4. The v5 draft meets the condition: it names the step as its own, grades the fit (tightest at the conduit pole, loosest at the integrator pole, where the test reads only the causal shadow of the real middle), and enters the topology gap (rotating vs fixed-star middle) as a real limit.

No anticipation-of-Φ claim: the bound is explicit ("not that Hegel anticipated the criterion, but that the boundary he drew and the boundary it computes are boundaries of the same shape"), and "the same boundary" was downgraded to same-shape everywhere it carries weight. No demotion of Φ: the instrument is affirmed ("thin and decidable is what makes it an instrument"; the receipts are "computed," the exact computation "needed" per STRUCTURAL_FINDINGS §7). Two watch notes only: the close's panel-approved "the same boundary the criterion reads, not yet the same computation" is the single spot above same-shape altitude — keep both halves together in any later edit; "a cut and a count" in the final paragraph is method description, not demotion.

verdict.post:
Adversarial fact-check of the Post 3 grounding digest (v5), verified against the repo at /Users/ludwitt/iit-playground/pyphi-experiments and against primary/secondary sources on the web.

WHAT SURVIVED REFUTATION (verified, safe to use):

Lab receipts — all exact against the repo:
- 256-form census, 24 triadic (9.4%), Φ bands 232@0.0 / 8@0.5 / 16@2.0, P(triadic | mediator reads both)=15.0% (24/160): recomputed directly from org_frontier/corpus/results/population.csv (awk counts: 232/8/16; 160 reads-both, 24 triadic among them). Matches corpus/FINDINGS.md and STRUCTURAL_FINDINGS.md §2-3.
- Minimal pair pure_relay Φ=0.00 vs ats_strict_bottleneck Φ=2.00: FINDINGS.md table confirms; forms_library.py confirms ats_strict_bottleneck rule S=x0&x2 with rationale "S forwards iff resume-signal AND manager-profile; W,C each read only S." The digest's AND-gate gloss is backed.
- Committing chains Φ=2.000000 at n=3,4,5,6: multiparty/results/chains.csv confirms exactly (one balanced 2-part MIP each row).
- Relay chains factor Φ=0 at lengths 2,3,4: essays/mediated_or_irreducible.md confirms (sourced to recurrence/iit_experiments.py E3).
- q213: constrained dealer triadic Φ=2.0 core {M,D,B}; bypass → dealer leaves core, Φ 2.0→0.0, margin 2.0; clearinghouse intrinsic margin 0.0. FINDINGS.md matches.
- q11 rot_ring Φ=2 triadic full core n=3-6; q149 symmetric ring spread 0.000; q214 H5 symmetric Heider triad Φ=6.0 all three in core; q112 every core party holds a veto. All confirmed.

Primary Hegel passages — Sans OA PDF (Tübingen Sans_053.pdf) extracted and searched; every page-pin correct:
- "conceptual relations as such are real" on Sans p. 192 (print header mapping verified).
- "do not refer directly either to mind or to nature" on p. 202 (the previously un-anchored quote — confirmed).
- "the real middle term [reale Mitte]" on p. 203; "astonishing" p. 204; reductionism disavowal / "spirit as such transcends mechanism" / "detached and uninvolved manner" p. 206.
- di Giovanni cross-cites confirmed verbatim in Sans: "(90; 588)", "(133; 631)", "(143; 641)", "(145; 643)", "(145; 642)".
- DECISIVE for the §198 correction: Sans's own citation "§ 198 Remark; 273" appears on his p. 207. This independently confirms the digest's ruling that the state-triad is EL §198R (Remark, B&D p. 273), and that v5's "fix" to the main paragraph was a mis-correction. Cite §198R.
- Philology confirmed on both sides: Sans prints "[reale Mitte]" (PDF), Hegel's German is "die reelle Mitte" (Deutsches Textarchiv / zeno.org, WL 1816, Das Zentrum) — the note holds.

Secondary sources — bibliographic data and camp assignments verified:
- Moss 2013, IPQ 53(1):73-85, quote "a triad of syllogisms, which altogether constitute a process of alternating middle terms" verbatim in the PDC abstract.
- Christensen 2024, Erkenntnis, "Beyond Individualism and Holism," DOI 10.1007/s10670-024-00845-0, Aug 2024 (title/year/DOI confirmed).
- Stein 2016, Hegel Bulletin 37(1), DOI 10.1017/hgl.2016.8 (a review article of Vieweg — consistent with the digest's framing).
- Kreines 2006, Philosophy Compass 1(5):466-480 — and Kreines argues Hegel's philosophy "includes a metaphysics," so the "revival partisan, not neutral referee" label is correct.
- Pippin camp nuance correct: Realm of Shadows reads logic AS metaphysics, so "science of pure thinking, not deflationary" is the right guard.

DEFECTS / GATES: see corrections and residual_gates below. Net: the digest is well-grounded and its two self-flagged fixes (§198R; killing "no party is a veto") are both valid, but its proposed replacement wording "even thirds" is itself unbacked, and one direct quote is not verbatim-verified.
